name: Stripe Payments
description: Take card and wallet payments with Stripe Checkout: subscriptions, trials, plan changes, refunds and the customer portal. Works in test mode with Stripe's test keys.
author: Fledge

settings.label: Secret or restricted API key
settings.help: A key that starts with sk_test_ / rk_test_ (test mode) or sk_live_ / rk_live_ (live mode). A restricted key needs write access to Checkout Sessions, Customers, Subscriptions, Products and Billing portal, and read access to Invoices, Charges and Refunds (write for Refunds).

settings.label: Webhook signing secret
settings.help: Starts with whsec_. From the endpoint in the Stripe dashboard, or from `stripe listen` when testing locally. Several endpoints can be separated with commas.

settings.label: Stripe API version
settings.help: Fledge pins the API version so Stripe changes cannot surprise it. Leave this alone unless you know why.

settings.label: Billing portal headline
settings.help: Shown at the top of Stripe's customer portal when Fledge has to create the portal configuration itself.

settings.label: Product tax code
settings.help: Stripe's code for what you sell. The default is general electronically supplied services. Stripe needs a code when Managed Payments or Stripe Tax is on; pick a better fit from Stripe's list of product tax codes if there is one for your product.
